text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions; could you please describe when these symptoms started and if you have any history of similar episodes?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme disease (Erythema Migrans with early disseminated arthritis).

The patient's history of a self-resolving knee pain, recent camping in an endemic area (Minnesota), and the new onset of wrist pain with fever and malaise strongly suggests early disseminated Lyme disease. I am requesting blood tests to confirm this.
